title: Version 1.38.0
body:
Version 1.38.0

August 19th, 2023

Added:

  • Added Scientist, she'll tell you when the next meteor hits for a price
  • Familiar Place badge is now obtainable
  • Added a pathway towards the mysterious mushrooms
  • Added a sign to help signify where to sell resources

Changed:

  • Improved obtainability of Burning Doorway badge
  • Version # now shows in loading screen
  • Mysterious mushroom entrance ramp is less steep
  • Removed the rocks from the grasslands, to better open the area

Bug Fixes:

  • Added more antigravity regions to improve getting hit

Version 1.38.1

August 19th, 2023

Added:

  • Added Slate below all acid
  • Added translational string to Emberbane
  • Added new pathway for the mysterious mushroom cave

Changed:

  • Increased spawn rate of trees in savannah, acid area, and desert

Bug Fixes:

  • Fixed Meteors spawning rapidly sometimes
  • Fixed Grabby (and hand) fly with Crates
